children: Multiple tech executives who appeared on stage at the New York Times DealBook Summit on Wednesday had high praise for former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. A sampling:
OpenAI President Greg Brockman called Huang "singular," while OpenAI CEO Sam Altman added that it was "hard to imagine the AI industry without Jensen."
"Nobody can take Jensen's place in this critical juncture," said Anduril Founder Palmer Luckey.
Elon Musk of Tesla and SpaceX likened Huang's ouster to "kicking Michael Jordan off your team when you're on a winning streak." He said he would hire Huang.
This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).
